name: Takahata (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Takahata town emblem in white: an outlined disc enclosing the character 高 in horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Takahata, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 January 1964.

features.role: Takahata town emblem — an outlined disc enclosing the character 高 in horizontal bars
